Mod.Author: JakeIsYoshi
Mod.Name: PSX Battle Shadows and Vertex Snapping
Mod.Description: This mod change the look of shadows during battles to match the original PlayStation. A few presets are available, as well as an additional option that gives you access to Vertex Snapping Effect. -REQUIRES 7th Heaven 4.4.0.67+ and FFNx 1.23.0.159+ -This mod is not compatible with Advanced Lighting or Cosmos Gaia -Additional Author: Pashtarot -Special thanks: Chrysalis, Kuraudo
